body:
③ 直派任务 — maintainer direct dispatch, filed by the director seat (summon #27, `session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`). `domain:skills` · `tooling` (the PM loop's own protocol). Takes the lane's pick order first as a 直派插队卡, ⛔ but only after the serial constraint below clears.
Blocked-by: #19061
Unlock-action: re-check PR #19694

**Provenance (who / verbatim / where):** the maintainer, chat with the director seat, 2026-09-22, answering decision batch #213 — 「1 2 4 同意」. Item 4 as presented: 「协议主文 819 → 约 300 行(红线 + 状态模型 + 入口 + 索引),派发 / 复核 / 入队细则各成一份按阶段读的 reference;同时删 core-rules.md 双份」. Standing directions it serves: 「更新你的技能」 (batch #211 standing rulings on #19647) and the maintainer's repeated 「淡化门禁 / 创业阶段不扩散」.

## Readings (director seat, `origin/main` `40626bdca6`, 2026-09-22T10:3xZ)

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`: 819 lines / 76.7 KB, 201 「⛔」 lines (≈ one per four lines). `references/core-rules.md`: 151 lines, self-described at `SKILL.md:43` as 「本文的子集」 with the rule 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」 — a maintained duplicate. `references/*.md` + `references/lanes/*.md`: 1,590 + 360 lines. An execution seat's first read per fire ≈ SKILL.md + core-rules + its lane file + AGENTS.md ≈ 178 KB.
- Industry reading (director's comparison, 2026-09-22): peer fleets run on one short readiness/conventions page plus per-repo instructions; the length here is the cost of every seat re-reading detail it does not need on that fire.
- **Serial constraint**: PR #19694 (`Part of #19061` step ②, skills seat, draft) touches `SKILL.md`, `references/contract-review.md`, `references/core-rules.md`, `references/platform-readings.md` — the same files. ⛔ This card starts only after PR #19694 is on `origin/main` (the `Unlock-action:` line above); a dev who starts earlier will collide.

## Ruled shape — ⛔ not open for re-design

1. **Relocation, not deletion, and no semantic change.** Every rule line of today's `SKILL.md` ends up in exactly one place: `SKILL.md` if it is principle (红线, 优先级, 入口与角色 with its args table, 状态模型 table, 全体座位的不变量, 域车道 table, the four-axis block in 升级与决策 — the single copy `check:skill-frame-sync` guards — 机械守卫索引, 模板与表), or one per-phase reference otherwise (suggested shape: `references/seat-lifecycle.md` for 开轮互斥 / 座位贴 / 收班, `references/triage-duties.md`, `references/execution-duties.md` for 候选 / 认领 / 派发 / 收集 / 复核, and the existing `landing-operations.md` absorbing 入队与落地; the dev may choose different file names and says why). Proof in the PR body: the count of 「⛔」 lines across `SKILL.md` + `references/**` before == after, and a table mapping each moved section to its destination.
2. `SKILL.md` lands at **≈ 300 lines** (a ceiling of 340); `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`'s ceiling for it is lowered to the landed count in the same PR (降恒合法, no maintainer citation needed for a decrease).
3. **`references/core-rules.md` is deleted.** Every pointer to it is retargeted or removed: `SKILL.md:43` and `:89`, `references/lanes/director.md`, `scripts/pm/git-history.mjs`'s 三章程 `touch` list, and whatever `git grep -n core-rules` finds on the head. Where a rule reads differently in the two files, `SKILL.md`'s wording wins (core-rules is the declared subset).
4. Each phase reference opens with one line saying which seat reads it on which fire, so a seat loads only its phase.
5. ⛔ No new rule, ⛔ no rule dropped, ⛔ no gate, hook, ratchet or roster added (新增门禁默认否); ⛔ no change to `os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`. `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`, `check:pm-governed-prose` green on the head.
6. `Clause-②: no`. Tier S (`.claude/**`): built at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (强制条款① — the protocol semantic surface), landed by the skills seat after an in-seat at-tier `## Contract review` PASS through the queue; `skip-changeset`. One PR, `Fixes` this card.
